title: Multi-agent systems: roles, delegation and evidence

questions.question: When is a separate agent role justified?
options: When it has a cool name
When it owns a distinct input, capability boundary or evaluation method
Whenever a prompt exceeds one paragraph
questions.explanation: A role earns its place by a real responsibility and a checkable boundary.

questions.question: What should a reviewer receive with a proposed result?
options: The evidence and an evaluation rubric
questions.explanation: Evidence and explicit criteria give a reviewer something inspectable to evaluate.
